description: This PHP class defines a Data Transfer Object (DTO) named 'Salary', which is used within the OrangeHRM system to represent salary-related data for employees. It includes methods for conversion to array, utilizes traits for employee salary services, and maps fields to getter methods.

classes.name: Salary
classes.description: Data Transfer Object for employee salary information within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor to initialize the Salary DTO with an employee number.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Converts salary data to an array based on specified fields, fetching data via the employee salary service.

methods.name: getFieldGetterMap
methods.description: Provides mapping of field names to getter methods for data normalization.
